svg.aria-label: Index card. Voyance: hotel inventory planning. Decides which hotel-weeks to pre-buy on a budget. Recovers demand hidden by sell-outs and weighs the risk of unsold rooms. Key result: +14–24% profit (simulated). TBO VoyageHack 4.0. Python, SciPy, FastAPI.
